app.js.reason: Fail-closed candidate merge (answer/solution conflicts become sticky and block formal admission) plus teacher-facing reliability fixes: the remembered view is restored before the first await, and a failed card edit is reported and rolled back to the stored truth. Then the deterministic MathType/MTEF restoration: the app's existing DOCX extraction path resolves each MathType OLE object through Qisi.DocxPipeline, keeps the formula evidence per file, and never reads the OLE control text. 2026-09-16: the DOCX SILENT WRONG CONTENT fix - the paragraph reader only reads real text elements (no structural element can become text), the flat question splitter moved to qisi-utils with the mark-sheet and image-token marker rules, and option evidence is only accepted from text that belongs to the question being filled. Then the support-file active anchor and the missing explicit answer rule: an answer/solution marker may sit behind an inline image token, and a 详解 conclusion such as 故选C is reported to the teacher but never written into the answer field. Then the withheld question rule: a question that still carries an unresolved MathType formula keeps the token visible, is marked withheld with rejected provenance for the affected field, and cannot be admitted until a teacher fills it in, while the option-label normalizer no longer rewrites the token's own tail. Then the section-header and answer-value rules found while verifying the remaining real groups: a section header without a colon types its questions, and an answer written without a label keeps its own value instead of being dropped. Then the answer-key stream rule: a key is located by its heading and read as one sequence of number/value entries, so several answers per line and wrapped lines no longer lose the key, while a value that crosses a line break is dropped rather than swallowing an orphan fragment. Continuous ingestion audit: deterministic DOCX extraction, numbering, formula/image evidence and removal of order-based repair; PDF text/geometry inspection, bounded recognition, existing support gates, field evidence and withheld-source-page review. Owner authorization and scope: INGESTION_AUDIT_PLAN_2026_09_16.md; validation: PDF_INSPECTION_STAGE_2026_09_16.md. Then the answer-key boundary rule: the key section is read as answer entries only and never as 解析 prose (it had put another question key line into 高二 question 49 solution), and a number the key gives twice with different values attaches no answer at all. Then the sticky answer conflict: a conflict keeps every disagreeing value as evidence, leaves the field empty, and a later candidate can no longer fill a field that is empty only because of the conflict. Then the visible conflict evidence: a question whose answer the ingestion dropped because the answer key states two different values names both values on the question and is flagged with answerConflict, instead of showing an empty answer without a reason. Then the teacher-reported 周二晚测 round: the shared DOCX extraction layer keeps Word superscript/subscript runs as inline LaTeX (a w:vertAlign run becomes ^{n}/_{n} together with the formula characters around it, and an adjacent existing math segment is merged instead of leaving "$$"), so "z1 / m2" no longer reaches a draft as a silently wrong formula; the MTEF reader also stretches a vector accent over a multi-letter base (\vec{BC} renders over the first letter only, \overrightarrow{BC} covers both). Extraction, ingestion and admission owners are unchanged. Then the figure-ownership rule of the same round: a Word figure anchored in front of a question marker no longer sits above that question text (it moves to the end of the stem), and it is handed to the immediately following question only when the owning question's own text carries no figure cue, the next question's text begins with 如图/见图/下图/图中, and the next question has no figure yet - the 周二晚测 case where the 扇形 OPQ figure belonged to question 12 but was attached to question 11. Extraction, ingestion, binding and admission owners are unchanged; the rule lives in Qisi.ReviewDraftState and app.js only calls it before the existing DOCX image binding. Then the formula-labelled options of the same round: when a question ends up with no options at all, a run of two or more label-led maths segments ('\.\\\\frac{\\\\pi }{4}\$ \.…\$', labels ascending from A with only whitespace between them) is read out of the stem as its options, in qisi-utils.extractFormulaLabelledOptions. On the real 周二晚测.docx that gives questions 4 and 6 their four options back and types them 单选题 instead of 解答题, so the review page no longer shows the options glued together; a question that already has options is never touched. Extraction, ingestion and admission owners are unchanged.
